title: VESTA telemetry frame
description: JSON Lines, one flat frame per line (a JSON array is also accepted). A field that is absent is unknown and no predicate on it fires. No interpolation: the player holds the last frame.

simulated.description: true for every scripted scenario; the UI shows SIMULATED whenever it is not explicitly false

smoke_pct_alarm.description: smoke reading as a percentage of the detector's alarm threshold

o2_percent.description: cabin oxygen, percent by volume; with pressure_kpa it is the design point of every decision in that frame

material_reported.description: a crew report naming the burning material; matched against material_id by slug

si_provenance.activity: SI-assisted VESTA authorship and deterministic processing; attributed NASA quotations remain source text.

source_boundary.nasa: Verbatim NASA quote fields and original PSI raw table cells are NASA source content, not SI-generated evidence. Table transcriptions retain source-file and row references; this is not a claim that every exported file is byte-identical to a NASA download.
source_boundary.vesta: Claims, summaries, rules, titles, normalizations, inferred conditions, rankings, coverage labels and scripted telemetry/decisions are VESTA interpretations or processing authored with SI assistance. Quote gates verify text matching, not scientific correctness. Deterministic runtime computation does not call an SI model.
source_boundary.imagery: Original NASA photographs and mosaics retain their NASA/partner credits, not an SI-generation watermark. Shader flames, smoke, geometry and reconstructed lighting are SI-assisted VESTA illustrations, not NASA observations.
source_boundary.nasa_notice: NASA has not reviewed or endorsed VESTA's SI-assisted interpretations and is not responsible for their accuracy.
